summary: RETEST of iteration_78 issues at 390x800 for sales@kainnusantara.id. localStorage.kn_force_desktop cleared before login. All 10 hub buttons under mobile-tab-btn-more (orders, amendments, returns, internal-requests, customers-crm, hr-visits, md-products, cs-price-list, inventory-board, inventory-lots) tested with NORMAL clicks (no force=True) after scroll_into_view_if_needed. Each opens the full responsive view correctly: URL becomes ?view=<view>, floating [mobile-back-to-app] visible, and the corresponding [hub-tab-<view>] is rendered (active in its hub tab bar). Clicking mobile-back-to-app on every hub returns to mobile-sales-app. Returns full view (mobile-hub-returns) at 390px: documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth === 390 (diff=0), confirming the PaginationBar flex-wrap fix eliminated the prior 156px horizontal overflow. Confirms iteration_78 suspected root cause (chip covered by fixed bottom tabbar led to force-click landing on mobile-tab-btn-orders/amendments) — with scroll_into_view + normal click the chips are reachable above the tabbar, and orders/amendments open exactly like the other 8 hubs. No console errors during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: PaginationBar right-side group flex-wrap prevents min-width overflow on narrow (390px) responsive pages inside .m-main. Consider adding a regression check (Cypress/Playwright) that documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth on all mobile hub full views to catch future regressions.

The 'chip under fixed bottom tabbar' class of bug is easy to reintroduce; the added scroll-padding/scroll-margin is good, but consider also adding a bottom safe-area padding to the More hub scroll container equal to the tabbar height so users can scroll chips fully into a tap-safe zone without needing programmatic scroll.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 hubs open, 10/10 back-to-app returns, returns overflow = 0px)

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_78 mobile hub full-view issue is fully resolved. Chips must be scrolled into view before clicking (test used scroll_into_view_if_needed + normal click). No force=True needed. Returns page horizontal overflow fix (PaginationBar flex-wrap) is confirmed at 390px.
rca of the issue: Prior iteration_78 failure on mobile-hub-orders/amendments was NOT a state/race bug in openFullView — it was a UI/hit-test artifact. The two chips at the end of the More list were rendered underneath the fixed bottom tab bar; when the test used force=True the click bypassed hit-test occlusion and Playwright's coordinate-based click actually reached the bottom tabbar's mobile-tab-btn-orders (which navigates to sales-home flow), so activeView appeared to 'revert' to sales-home. Mitigation applied by main agent (scroll-padding/scroll-margin so chips scroll above the tabbar) plus using non-forced clicks resolves the issue for real users and tests alike. Returns page overflow RCA: PaginationBar's right-side control group had no wrap; on 390px the combined width of per-page selector + CSV + total pushed the row beyond viewport. Fix: flex-wrap on that group — verified diff=0.
